guide.title: Fraud prevention guide
guide.lead: What to check before a deal · common scams and how to stop them · what to do if you are harmed.
guide.platform: What SogaeBank does and does not do

safe.sub: Deals of {amount} or more · both parties agree (B-04)
safe.what: It adds party verification, dispute support and record keeping to the deal. Payment goes directly between the parties — SogaeBank never receives or holds the money.
safe.who: It applies to deals where the contract amount is {amount} or more, once buyer and seller both agree.
safe.how: Press “Agree to safe deal” on your deal page (the other party is notified). It applies once both of you press it.
safe.applySub: Deals whose contract amount meets the threshold

guide.ifHurt: If you were harmed or suspect fraud
guide.moneyLoss: Report it to both the police (112) and the Korean National Police Agency's cybercrime reporting system. SogaeBank keeps chat and contract records.
guide.reportSub: Report a listing, member or deal

cases.title: Fraud cases
cases.warn: This is a member's personal account — SogaeBank has not verified the facts. Phone numbers, emails and account numbers were masked when saved.
cases.reportSub: If you were harmed, report it right away
cases.newLead: Sharing what happened helps prevent the same harm. The author is not disclosed.
cases.newLogin: Login required. Only members who have completed identity verification can post.
